market_outlook.short_term: Markets stabilizing post-Fed hike with oil decline providing relief. SPY turning a corner per Citadel. Volatility elevated on Iran war and rate path uncertainty. Housing weakness and T-Mobile competition drag specific sectors. 1-3 months: range-bound with upside capped by inflation data, downside limited by resilient labor (196K claims).
market_outlook.long_term: Supply-side era per Lazard suggests structural shift favoring energy, infrastructure, and AI capex. Inflation in cyclical upswing implies 1-2 more hikes. China de-dollarization is a slow-burn structural risk. AI infrastructure cycle has multi-year runway. Housing correction may extend 6-9 months. Defense faces political overhang through midterms.
